mashup_name: Black Ops II Zombies x CS2 Loadouts
description: A Black Ops II Zombies/custom-map mashup that pulls Counter-Strike 2 weapon audio and loadout data from the player's installed CS2 folder. The player launches Black Ops II with a custom GSC script loader (T6SP-Mod style) that applies CS2-style weapon sounds, perk equivalents, and buy-round economy to BO2 Zombies co-op.
host_game: Call of Duty: Black Ops II

required_games.name: Call of Duty: Black Ops II

solo_or_multiplayer: Multiplayer co-op (2-4 players in BO2 Zombies)
player_first_minute: Launch BO2 Zombies, select CS2 loadout (AK-47 / M4A4 style class), hear CS2 weapon audio in first wave
first_playable_version: One custom Zombies map with CS2 weapon sounds, 2 loadout options, basic economy UI overlay
